label: Case Severity
description: How bad it is if nothing happens — CASE_RECORD.data.severity. Ordered by sort_order, worst first. Spellings used before this vocabulary existed are aliases of the term they meant, so old cases keep their text and still resolve. Curated: deprecate, don't delete.

terms.label: Security
terms.description: A security exposure: data or access reachable by someone who should not have it, a secret leaked, an authentication or authorisation gap.

terms.label: Blocks me
terms.description: Work stops until it is fixed; there is no workaround.

terms.label: Wrong result
terms.description: Wrong or lost data, or a silent failure: it looks fine and is not. Work goes on but cannot be trusted.

terms.label: Degraded
terms.description: Works, but slowly, unreliably, or only with a workaround.

terms.label: Annoying
terms.description: Friction or extra effort; nothing is actually wrong.
aliases: mixed (catalogue contains load-bearing, annoying, and cosmetic items)

terms.label: FYI
terms.description: No action expected; recorded for information.
